newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Heracles Cement H1 pretax jumps 63.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Heracles Cement H1 pretax jumps 63.5pct.

text.p: Greece's Heracles Cement said its first-half profits soared 63.5 percent to 5.1 billion drachmas from 3.1 billion a year earlier and its turnover rose 7.9 percent to 42.2 billion drachmas from 39.1 billion.
The volume of sales in the domestic market recovered in the second quarter after falling in the first quarter due to bad weather conditions, it said in a statement.

The net worth of AGET Heracles Cement on June 30, 1996 stood at 66.2 billion drachmas compared to 62 billion on June 30, 1995. The group's net worth stood at 67.2 billion drachmas at the end of the first half compared to 61.5 billion.
